R1_post7.name: Pmontgom
R1_post7.text:
Just to explain the discrepancy between what’s in the earlier messages and where you can find the data today: When the paper was released, we temporarily created a dataset in Data Explorer called “ NextGen Model Manuscript 2026 ” containing these new screens. 
 However, since then we’ve released the 26Q3 data, where the organoid lines have been processed with all other CRISPR screens. Since you can now find the new models in the harmonized CRISPR dataset, we’ve removed the temporary dataset. See Yejie’s message for how to find organoid data within CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (which is the name you can find under “Downloads”. This same data is labeled “CRISPR (DepMap Public 26Q3+Score, Chronos)” in Data Explorer) 
 Thanks, 
 Phil
